notes.title: Full Version - Release Date is here!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Animal Lovers! 🎊[/b][/h1]

[h3]Finally, after all this time we're incredibly excited to announce something that you waited for a long time! 🔥[/h3]

Throughout the first Playtest, Demo, Prologue, hard work of our team, polishing, implementing months of your feedback, requests, ideas and now we have a game that is ready for the launch! 🤩

[h2][b]🗓️ The release date for Animal Shelter 2 is:[/b][/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658510/Animal_Shelter_2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/59d7388851d96335adde38364adee1a66f9fe5eb.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658510/Animal_Shelter_2/

[previewyoutube=Ar1GdZdh0ck;full][/previewyoutube]
Those were crazy [b]537 DAYS[/b] since our announcement of the game and not a single one of those days would be meaningful without you 🫵 You gave us so much and and now we're ready to give all the love back to you! 😻

Yeah, the release is not that far, and we can't wait to show you what we have prepared for you in the full version of the game! ☺️

We worked hard to get closer and closer to something you will trully love. This date is a significant monument for us, the proof of what we created, which is a an amazing experience for you to enjoy the game. 🐱 🐶


[h1][b]Donations, Challenges and Contests! 🏆[/b][/h1]
Get ready for the coming days... 👀 We have some interesting activities for you to enjoy while you wait for the premiere! 🤭

[h3]The first challenge is the [b]Community Group Challenge[/b]! 😻 

Make sure to check out the entry below to learn more 👇[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2658510/view/546739082808525241][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052794/fdf32fbd5c97a6be269ffea7e45ccd903fb13d4f.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/yDJUSSxRFV][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/04aaee60c314cb7eba5ee7af51639e5cfb0ab764.png[/img][/url]

See you soon!
Animal Shelter 2 Team

notes.title: Release Date Set! 😻
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Get ready Animal Lovers! 😻[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]The next BIG step in the development of Animal Shelter 2 will start next week![/b][/h2]

[h3][b]On September 13th at 5:00 PM CEST you will be able to play the free Prologue for Animal Shelter 2! 🥳[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887780/Animal_Shelter_2_Prologue/

[h3]But that's not all... Let your friends know to save time next week because the Prologue will be f[b]ully available in CO-OP mode[/b]! 🤯[/h3]

🗓️ Mark your calendars and prepare to experience the new features and improvements firsthand - [b]SEPTEMBER 13, 2024 at 5:00 PM CEST[/b]

In the meantime, while we wait for the premiere of the Prologue, check out the latest trailer below, showing the progress of changes from Animal Shelter 1 to the release of the Prologue for Animal Shelter 2

[previewyoutube=u1Azx7_YBlE;full][/previewyoutube]
That's not all... 👀 we have prepared for you in the coming days - we would also like to present to you a list of key changes that have occurred since the development of Animal Shelter 2: Prologue, so stay tuned!


Hop on over to Discord to chat with us and other members of our community! 👇
[url=https://discord.gg/yDJUSSxRFV][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/71bc1a3f390b736c7d108102b6e05e4572bced4f.png[/img][/url] 

See you soon,
Animal Shelter 2 Team
